name: Network Visualization
summary: Draws a static 2D visualisation of a network with the Large Graph Layout (LGL) force-directed algorithm in igraph, colouring and sizing nodes by a chosen property, and saves it as a PDF.
description: Loads a network in JGF format, lays it out with LGL and plots it with node colour and size taken from a node property (degree by default, or communities detected by another App), optionally with labels. Use it for a quick visual check of connectivity matrices or derived networks; edge weights must be non-negative.

inputs.description: Input network. Currently, visualization only works if the edge weights are non negative. Please use the preprocess app to prepare the network.

outputs.description: Static visualization of the network in pdf.

parameters.description: Uses the provided property as color. If the network has communities detected by the "Network Communities" App, you can provide "communitiy" to plot communities as colors.
Makes the size of nodes proportional to the provided property.
Plot labels on top of nodes.

citations.text: Avesani P et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6:69 (2019).
Adai AT, Date SV, Wieland S, Marcotte EM. LGL: creating a map of protein function with an algorithm for visualizing very large biological networks. J Mol Biol 340(1):179-190 (2004).
